description_en: Queries the SQL sample data for the new version of the performance insight feature of a database instance
description_zh: 调用GetPfsSqlSample接口，获取性能洞察（新版）功能的SQL样本数据
name: GetPfsSqlSample

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

Only ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances and PolarDB for MySQL clusters are supported
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
仅支持RDS MySQL和PolarDB MySQL版数据库实例
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The node ID.

For ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL Cluster Edition instances or PolarDB for MySQL clusters, you must specify the node ID
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。

对于RDS MySQL集群系列或PolarDB MySQL版数据库实例，需要提供节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为unix时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time. You can view the data of up to seven days in the previous 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，格式为unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间，最多可查看最近一个月内任意七天的数据
parameters.name: end_time

CreateTmpDiskTables.description_en: The number of internal on-disk temporary tables that were created when the SQL statement was executed
CreateTmpDiskTables.description_zh: 执行语句时创建的磁盘上内部临时表的数量

CreateTmpTables.description_en: The number of internal temporary tables that were created when the SQL statement was executed
CreateTmpTables.description_zh: 执行语句时创建的内部临时表的数量

EndEventId.description_en: The end ID of the event. By default, the value of this parameter is NULL when the event starts and is changed to the event ID when the event ends
EndEventId.description_zh: 该参数在事件开始时默认为NULL，在事件结束时更新为线程当前事件编号

Errors.description_en: The number of errors returned for the SQL statement

LockLatency.description_en: The lock wait duration. Unit: millisecond
LockLatency.description_zh: 锁等待时间，单位为毫秒

LogicId.description_en: The ID of the logical database

NoGoodIndexUsed.description_en:
Indicates whether the server failed to find an index that can be used for the SQL statement. Valid values:

1: yes.

0: no
NoGoodIndexUsed.description_zh:
服务器是否查找不到可用于该语句的索引：

1：是。
0：否

NoIndexUsed.description_en:
Indicates whether table scans were performed when indexes were not used. Valid values:

1: yes.

0: no
NoIndexUsed.description_zh:
语句在不使用索引的情况下是否执行了表扫描：

1：是。
0：否

NodeId.description_en:
The node ID.

This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL Cluster Edition instances or PolarDB for MySQL clusters
NodeId.description_zh:
节点ID。

RDS MySQL集群系列或PolarDB MySQL版数据库实例才会返回该数据

RowsAffected.description_en: The number of rows affected by the SQL statement

RowsExamined.description_en: The number of rows scanned by the SQL statement

RowsSent.description_en: The number of rows returned by the SQL statement
RowsSent.description_zh: 返回的SQL语句的当前行数

SelectFullJoin.description_en:
The number of joins that are used to perform table scans without using indexes.

: This parameter is used for the scenario in which indexes are not used in a union query. If the returned value is not 0, check the indexes of tables
SelectFullJoin.description_zh:
不使用索引而执行表扫描的连接数。
<notice>该参数是用来统计联合查询过程中没有利用索引的情况，如果该参数值不为0，请仔细检查表的索引。
</notice>

SelectFullRangeJoin.description_en: The number of joins that used ranges on referenced tables
SelectFullRangeJoin.description_zh: 在引用表上使用范围搜索的连接数

SelectRange.description_en: The number of joins that used ranges on the first table
SelectRange.description_zh: 在第一个表中使用范围的连接数量

SelectRangeCheck.description_en:
The number of joins that did not have key values. The keys and values were checked for each row of data.

: This parameter is used for the scenario in which indexes are not used in a union query. If the returned value is not 0, check the indexes of tables
SelectRangeCheck.description_zh:
在每一行数据后对键值进行检查，统计不带键值的连接的数量。
<notice>该参数是用来统计联合查询过程中没有利用索引的情况，如果该参数值不为0，请仔细检查表的索引。
</notice>

SortMergePasses.description_en: The number of merges that the sorting algorithm must perform
SortMergePasses.description_zh: 排序算法必须执行的合并次数

SortRange.description_en: The number of times the data was sorted by using ranges
SortRange.description_zh: 使用范围进行排序的次数

SortScan.description_en: The number of sorts that were performed during table scans

Timestamp.description_en: The time when the SQL statement was executed. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
Timestamp.description_zh: 执行SQL的时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒

Warnings.description_en: The number of warnings returned for the SQL statement

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request was successful, Successful is returned. If the request failed, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。

请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
